items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I think I met the actor Al Freeman, his son. I think I met him one time in New York.

ctx.x: I wondered if it might be. I mean Al Freeman is not a terribly unusual name.
Uh-huh. Uh-huh. That's his son. I think I met the actor Al Freeman, his son. I think I met him one time in New York. But that is his son. Al Freeman has passed on, the dad.
That's good to know about that relationship.
